messages:
alex: Heads-up — planned boot for an isolated on-prem cluster at ACME (EMEA) tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Using this thread to finalise checklist: seed images, firewall rules, GPU quota bump, and handoff roster.

mira: Ack. Can we confirm customer-provided BGP session details? need ASN + neighbor IPs.

sam: I have ASN 64512 and neighbor 10.10.254.1 from the ticket. I'll paste the config after lunch.

leah: Also need MTU confirmation. Their edge switches are set to 9000. Our default is 1500 — will set jumbo on the host NICs if ops ok.

alex: Good catch. @mira please note: change host MTU to 9000 for 3 GPU nodes during bootstrap. We'll test packet fragmentation.

mira: Noted. Also: air-gapped image flow — do we have signed seed tarball staged on the USB delivery yet?

sam: Deploy-bot shows artifact v2.3.1-seed signed and checksum uploaded to the shared s3 (airgap bucket). I'll attach sha256: `e3b0c44298fc1c149...` in ticket 8912.

leah: Can someone validate the image unpack script? last time one of the GPUs failed to pick up firmware. snippet below that we run on the seed host:```bash
./unpack-seed.sh --image /mnt/seed/v2.3.1.tar.gz --verify-sha256
reboot && ./apply-firmware.sh
```

alex: We'll run that in canary on node-edge-01 first. Sam, you're on canary today?

sam: Yep. I'll monitor dmesg and nvml. Also will run `nvidia-smi topo --matrix` after boot to confirm device visibility.

mira: Network-wise: firewall needs rules for private control-plane CIDR -> customer management CIDR (TCP 22, 443, 9411 for tracing, 9090 for prometheus). Confirmed with network team.

leah: Also add rules for registry sync: allow outbound to our airgap-sync appliance on port 8443. Their proxy requires SNI to match `redwood-sync.local`.

alex: Cost note — this cluster will attach 6xA100-style devices. Finance flagged that hourly baseline will be ~ $X/hr in their quote. I'll push a one-line cost summary to the customer before handoff.

sam: Health checks we'll run post-boot: kubelet ready, GPU plugin pod ready, infer-runtime responding to /health, sample 1k token run to measure tail latency.

mira: Who's on the handoff roster? I'll compile and add to the runbook.

alex: Roster: Alex (lead), Sam (bootstrap + gpu validation), Mira (network + acceptance), Leah (image + firmware), + Customer Onsite SME (TBD).

leah: For HSM/KMS: their keywrap is in KMS partition 2. Need customer to do final seal/unseal during window. Schedule that for +30m after cluster boot.

sam: Quick note: if GPU counts mismatch (reported vs expected), don't re-provision node. Power-cycle and rerun firmware apply; if still mismatch, escalate to hw-ops and open incident.

mira: ops checklist rough order: preflight (BGP, MTU, ACLs), seed unpack, firmware apply, boot canary, gpu health, runtime smoke, perf probe, handoff call. I'll put this into the runbook.

alex: Perfect. Meeting invite for 09:30 UTC tomorrow to walk through checklist live. Final question: any latency-sensitive routing we should pin?

leah: For now we'll pin control-plane traffic to path A (lowest jitter) via policy route. Customer confirmed link1 has SLA.

sam: I'll post quick `nfdump` capture after canary to check for fragmentation issues.

deploy-bot: artifact v2.3.1-seed has been verified on airgap repo (signed). CI: 24/24 green.

alex: Great. If no blockers, we'll proceed. Last call: anyone need extra infra notes added?

mira: Add note: NTP must be reachable via internal stratum, otherwise kube certs will fail rotation.

leah: Add firmware rollback steps and contact hw-ops pager.

sam: I'll paste the `nvidia-smi` smoke commands to the runbook before the meeting.

alex: Thanks team — we’ll sync 09:30 UTC. :thumbsup:
